others.route: Permit for recruiting foreign labour, then an entry visa for residence and work (Decree No. 212 of 2009; Labour Relations Law No. 12 of 2010)

note: Added 2026-11-01 from the permit research (papers.permits.LY), which says every foreign worker needs the permit: every foreign worker is recruited on a permit for recruiting foreign labour, and the entry visa for residence and work is issued on it (Decree No. 212 of 2009, art. 1); the permit is given to the project's entity for the numbers, specialities and country of recruitment, and only where no Libyan can fill the post (art. 2(3)). The decision's Arabic original, as DCAF's database holds its scan (an Eastlaws copy of the signed decision, not the Official Gazette's page), names the Labour and Vocational Training Authority as the permit's issuer, where DCAF's English text names the Ministry of Labour and Rehabilitation; the route named the Ministry until 2026-11-03, and names neither now.

sources.title: Libya Security Sector Legislation database (DCAF), General People's Committee Decree No. (212) of 1377 FDP (2009 AD), English translation
sources.said: Entry visas for the purpose of residence and work shall be issued on the basis of a permit for recruiting foreign labour issued by the Ministry of Labour and Rehabilitation in accordance with the prescribed procedures. … Permits for recruiting labour shall be issued for the entity in charge of the project and shall contain the required number of people that are to be recruited, their specialisations and the country of recruitment. In all cases, the lack of a capable Libyan person to fulfil the position or job for which the foreigner is being recruited must be verified.

sources.title: Scan of the General People's Committee's Decision No. 212 of 1377 (2009), Arabic original, as held by DCAF's Libya security-legislation database (pages 1-2 read by Arabic OCR, tesseract ara; OCR errors kept)
sources.said: مادة(1) تصدر تأشيرات الدخول للأغراض المختلفة المحسددة باللائحسة التنفيذية للقاتون رقسم (6] لسسنة 1987 مسيحي المشار إليه . عن مصلحة الجوازات والجنسية وشؤون الأجائب . على أنه بالنسبة لتأشيرات الدخول لغرض الإقامة والعمل فبكون إصدارها بناء علي إنْن استجلاب العمالة الأجنبية ... مادة (2) تضع مصلحة العمل والتدريب المهني في شان العمالة الأجلبية الضوابط الآتية ... 3 منح الأذون لاستجلاب العمالة الأجنبية ... علي أن يصدر منح الإنن باستجلاب العمالة لصالح الجهة صاحبة انمشروع ؛ متضمنا الأعداد المطلسوب استجلايها وتخصصائها وبلد الاستجلاب . وفي جميع الأحوال يجب التأكد من عدم وجود عنصر ليبي قادر علي شغل الوظيفة
